landmarks.name: FIA-photo registered T27 outfield pavilion
landmarks.glazing: Dark recessed upper panes, cream lower corner/service panels and solid pale end piers observed in supplied289–293s. Estimated lower opaque extent is limited to two corner bays at each end; rear symmetry and exact service-door arrangement remain uncertain. Deeper pale roof fascia and visible triangulated supports replace the thin repeated members. Pane rhythm, pier width, fascia thickness and truss dimensions are visual estimates, not measured section controls.
landmarks.source_note: FIA 2025 event notes page 5 locates the T27 outfield staging area at 21°37′29.3″N, 39°06′23.7″E and photographs the actual two-level framed pavilion beside the race fence. Supplied 289–293 s shows the same pale/glazed corner context before the main-straight exit. The footprint is a reconstruction about 33 m east and 37 m north of that staging control, not an OSM building or survey. Dimensions and current glazing follow the direct visual baseline; the FIA preparation photo shows its exposed frame.

landmarks.name: The Jeddah EDITION terraced track frontage
landmarks.source: Supplied331.06s/overview04 establishes the track-facing deep terraces, projecting pale canopy and angled braces. Marriott's original exterior photograph establishes dark occupied facade piers, recessed floor-height windows, closed soffits and glass terrace guards. Its sea-facing lift tower/pergolas are not transferred onto the unregistered track elevation. Tier heights, bay pitches and sections remain architectural estimates; existing24.5m envelope and footprint are retained. New room bays are estimated subordinate detail, not a measured count. No ground, physics, barrier or lighting changes. Full-resolution331.06s also supports dominant pale deck fascias and restrained horizontal front glazing/shade bands. Floor fascia0.62m is an architectural estimate; deck tops stay fixed. Sea-facing curtain panels are omitted from the track facade. Highest canopy occupies an estimated75% of the long frontage,offset toward the positive-u end; its local-u/end assignment follows the native approach orientation and remains estimated. The opposite quarter is an18.28m lower roof terrace with a raised pale triangular end fin. Braces connect6.35→12.45m terraces rather than the incorrectold18.5m full-height members. All are visual silhouette estimates from direct331.06s,not survey. Visible braces lean down toward positive-u on the registered approach; exact repetitions/endregistration remain estimated.

Fresh native/cooked views remain required.

landmarks.name: Masarat five-finger residential complex
landmarks.source_limits: Original reconstructed architecture, not a surveyed footprint or section. The operator point is directions only. Masarat is CVU-estimated 144 m / 42 floors versus developer 43 storeys; Sail is a different 264.7 m tower. Component depths, 23–25-floor lower fingers, 27-floor return, corner bearing/top extent and stepped entry levels remain estimates. Actual original 4–10 m emitted ground may represent a raised site or DSM uncertainty; it is not proved bare earth. Rear connectors remain unmodeled. No full-site pad, fake building OSM ID, field/road/contact mutation, provider change or streaming-radius change. Normal-start residency uses an 8,192-source-pose estimate, not a moving native proof. Fresh native night and full-route review remain required.
